cmd: ls -la /app && which ffmpeg python3 pip3 2>/dev/null; cat /etc/os-release | head -3
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq ffmpeg tesseract-ocr python3-pip python3-venv 2>&1 | tail -3
pip3 install yt-dlp --break-system-packages -q 2>&1 | tail -2; ffmpeg -version | head -1; tesseract --version | head -1; yt-dlp --version
mkdir -p frames && ffmpeg -y -i video.mp4 -vf "fps=1/10" frames/sample_%03d.png 2>&1 | tail -2 && ls frames/
clear; tesseract frames/sample_010.png - 2>/dev/null | tail -25; echo "=====LAST====="; tesseract frames/sample_019.png - 2>/dev/null | tail -25
mkdir -p allframes && ffmpeg -y -i video.mp4 -vsync 0 allframes/f_%04d.png 2>&1 | tail -1; ls allframes | wc -l
cd /app/work && md5sum allframes/*.png > frame_hashes.txt && wc -l frame_hashes.txt && awk '{print $1}' frame_hashes.txt | sort -u | wc -l

cd /app/work && nproc; python3 -c "
seen=set()
uniq=[]
with open('frame_hashes.txt') as f:
    for line in f:
        h=line.split()[0]
        if h not in seen:
            seen.add(h)
            uniq.append(line.split()[1])
print(len(uniq))
print(uniq[:30])
"

cd /app/work && python3 -c "
seen=set()
uniq=[]
with open('frame_hashes.txt') as f:
    for line in f:
        h=line.split()[0]
        if h not in seen:
            seen.add(h)
            uniq.append(line.split()[1])
with open('uniq_frames.txt','w') as f:
    for u in uniq: f.write(u+'\n')
print('wrote', len(uniq))
"
mkdir -p ocr
cat uniq_frames.txt | xargs -P 64 -I{} bash -c 'base=$(basename {} .png); tesseract {} ocr/${base} --psm 6 2>/dev/null'
echo "OCR done"; ls ocr | wc -l
clear; echo "---"; ls ocr | wc -l; echo "---CPU quota---"; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; pkill -f tesseract; sleep 1; ps aux | grep -c tesseract

cd /app/work; time tesseract allframes/f_0100.png /tmp/t1 --psm 6 2>/dev/null; echo "=== try psm 4 ==="; time tesseract allframes/f_0100.png /tmp/t2 --psm 4 2>/dev/null; echo "=== downscale test ==="; ffmpeg -y -i allframes/f_0100.png -vf scale=640:-1 /tmp/small.png 2>/dev/null; time tesseract /tmp/small.png /tmp/t3 --psm 6 2>/dev/null
cd /app/work; echo "=== FULL (psm6) ==="; cat /tmp/t1.txt | head -30; echo "=== SMALL (psm6) ==="; cat /tmp/t3.txt | head -30

cd /app/work; rm -f ocr/*; cat uniq_frames.txt | xargs -P 8 -I{} bash -c 'base=$(basename {} .png); [ -f ocr/${base}.txt ] || tesseract {} ocr/${base} --psm 6 2>/dev/null'; echo "OCR DONE"; ls ocr | wc -l
